mapper.select: SELECT * FROM sys_user WHERE username = #{username} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM sys_user WHERE user_id = #{userId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_user SET nickname = #{user.nickname}, email = #{user.email}, avatar = #{user.avatar}, intro = #{user.intro} WHERE user_id = #{user.userId}

UPDATE sys_user SET last_login_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE user_id = #{userId}
